content.short: Disco provides pseudonymous identification and lets users carry credentials across services.
content.description: Disco is a chain-agnostic platform that relies on decentralized identifiers and verified credentials to help people reclaim ownership of their data. It gathers and organizes personalized information into a cohesive profile that you control, rather than letting scattered data stay siloed across services. You can selectively share parts of your profile with verifiers, such as institutions or social networks, choosing what to reveal and when. A stronger profile built on verified credentials enhances trust with others, communities, and the services you use.
content.meta: Disco uses decentralized identifiers and verified credentials to empower user data control. Discover Disco and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
